summary.en: A roof collapse at a school in Peshawar killed dozens of children and a teacher, prompting families to demand justice and authorities to order school inspections. The Pakistani government imposed emergency rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa amid rising tension, while the Taliban and Russia are drawing closer, increasing regional strain. Afghanistan is conducting an emergency border response as detailed in a ReliefWeb report covering late September to early October 2026. Robbers carried out three attacks in Islamabad's D-12 within 40 minutes, and Pakistan has ruled out unconditional talks with Afghanistan. Iran faces compounded security challenges from a rising domestic insurgency, according to Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty.
summary.nb: Et tak kollapset på en skole i Peshawar og drepte dusinvis av barn og en lærer, noe som fikk familier til å kreve rettferdighet og myndighetene til å beordre skoleinspeksjoner. Den pakistanske regjeringen innførte unntakstilstand i Khyber Pakhtunkhwa midt i økende spenning, mens Taliban og Russland kommer nærmere hverandre, noe som øker regional belastning. Afghanistan gjennomfører en nødgrenseoperasjon som beskrevet i en ReliefWeb-rapport som dekker slutten av september til begynnelsen av oktober 2026. Røvere gjennomførte tre angrep i Islamabad D‑12 innen 40 minutter, og Pakistan har avvist ubetingede samtaler med Afghanistan. Iran står overfor sammensatte sikkerhetsutfordringer fra en økende innenlandsk opprør, ifølge Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
